title: Dances and basketball in Xenia
summary: Visiting bands played dances, Lloyd Scott came from Springfield, and Xenia had a notable basketball team.

Anyway, they played dances there. And so did Lloyd Scott from right in Springfield.

You see, what they used to do, every weekend they'd have a big basketball game. And they had some of the greatest athletes of that time playing basketball with the Xenia team. They had Albert Hubbard(?) or something like that, Sol Butman(?)... These were jumpers. These guys were, you know, playing...you know, scoring, jumpin', high-jumpin' and things. They ...(?)... basketball. It was a big thing ...(?)...
